t: Kamma dinim middebarim haasurim beshabbat keen toladot meabot
s: Kamma dinim middebarim haasurim beshabbat keen toladot meabot ubo y"ch seipim: haggozez, ben min hachay ben min hammet, ben min behema vechayya, apillu min haor hammupshat — chayyab. Vehu meabot melakot, shekken bammishkan hayu gozezin orot hattechashim veelim. Abal hattolesh tzemer beyado min habbehema o mehaor — patur, sheen derek geziza bekak. Veken hannotel searo vetzippornayv beyadayv o beshinnayv — patur. Abal asur middibre soperim littol beyad, apillu laacherim, ap al pi sheeno yakol leammen yadayv littol yapeh belo keli laacherim. Abal im chatakan bikli — chayyab apillu al b' searot bilbad, veal achat patur, abal asur min hattora kishar chatzi shiur. Umelaqqet lebanot mittok shechorot shello yehe nireh zaqen — apillu beachat chayyab. Vedabar zeh apillu bechol asur, mishshum "lo yilbash geber simlat ishsha", shettargumo "lo yitettaqqen gebar betiqqune itteta":

En haggozez vehachotek tzippornayim bikli chayyab ella im ken tzarik latztzemer o lassear o latztzippornayim shechatak, abal im eno tzarik lahem — hare zo melaka sheenah tzerika legupah. Ulepikak, ishsha sheshshokcha meereb shabbat littol hatztzippornayim ubeshabbat hu lel tebilatah — yesh mi shemmattir lah lomar lenokrit lechattekan lah, shekkol dabar sheeno asur ella middibre soperim — muttar laasoto al yede nokri letzorek mitzva, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"z veshak"h. Abal yesh omerim sheap im eno tzarik latztzemer vesear vetzippornayim — chayyab (sheiqqar hammelaka hi haabarat hassear vehatztzemer mehaor, vehatztzippornayim mehaetzbaot, vahare hu tzarik legup haabara zo, veod) sheggam bammishkan hayu gozezim orot hattechashim ap al pi shello hayu tzerikim lisaran. Velaken en lehattir lomar lenokrit lechattekan, shezzehu shebut gamur, velo hittiruhu letzorek mitzva, kemo shennitbaer besimman ra"v, ella tomar lah littelan beyad o beshinnayim, shezzehu shebut dishbut. Veap shehi matta etzbeoteha eleha umesayyea immah qetzat — en bekak kelum, shemmesayyea en bo mammash (umuttar gamur min hattora. Veap middibre soperim en issur lesayyea ella leoseh melaka gemura o ledabar haasur, mishshum shebut shello bimqom mitzva, abal bimqom mitzva lo gazeru al hassiyyua, kemo shello gazeru al haamira lenokri, lepi shehu eno oseh kelum, veap besiyyua eno oseh meuma, shemmesayyea en bo mammash beemet, ella shehachakamim gazeru alayv gezera shemma yabo laasot beatzmo, abal haoseh maaseh — asur apillu hu shebut dishbut bimqom mitzva, kemo shennitbaer besimman shl"a):

Asur lachtok yabbelet miggupo, ben beyad ben bikli, ben lo ben laacherim, ben yabbelet lacha ben yebesha, veim chatak yabbelet lacha bikli — chayyab mishshum gozez lehamchayyebim mishshum geziza ap im eno tzarik lemah sheggazaz:

Hakkoteb vehammocheq al menat liktob bemaqom shemmachaq — meabot melakot hen, shekken hayu kotebin al qarshe hammishkan lesimman, leda ezeh ben zugo, upeamim shettaa vehaya mocheq mah shekkatab vechozer vekoteb bimqomo, abal limchoq shello al menat liktob lo haya bammishkan, veen zo meen melaka kelal. Vehoil vechiyyub hammocheq hu mishshum sheoseh ken al menat liktob, dehaynu shemmetaqqen maqom liktiba, lepikak apillu lo machaq otiyyot ella tishtush deyo bilbad, o shaava shennopla al happinqas, dehaynu luchot chaquqin vetuchin beshaava vechoqeqim alehem beet barzel, venopla aleha shaava acheret umechaqah vehesirah mishsham kede lachaqoq bimqomah al hashshaava shettachteha hattucha balluach — chayyab. Vehu sheyyehe bimqomo kede liktob o lachaqoq b' otiyyot. Veken hakkoteb o hammocheq otiyyot — eno chayyab ella al b' otiyyot. Abal al ot achat — patur, abal asur min hattora kishar chatzi shiur. Veken haddin bemocheq umesir shaava min haqqelap kede liktob bimqomah. Vehu haddin hammesir shaava shennotpa al haotiyyot, demah li metaqqen maqom liktiba umah li metaqqen otiyyot hakketubot, veadderabba zehu tiqqun yoter. Veyesh meqillin bezeh. Umiddibre soperim asur apillu limchoq shello al menat liktob, velaken asur lishbor uga sheasu aleha kemin otiyyot, ap al pi sheeno mekavven raq laakila, mippene shehu mocheq. Abal muttar littenah letinoq, lepi sheqqatan haoseh lahanaato — en tzarik lehaprisho, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shm"g. Veotan separim shekkatub alehem otiyyot berashe chudde haddappim — yesh oserin lepotchan beshabbat, mishshum mocheq, veken lenoolan, mishshum koteb. Veap sheeno mitkavven lekak? "Pesiq resheh velo yamut" hu. Veyesh mattirin lenoolan, lepi shekkevan shehaotiyyot hen ketubot kebar ella shemmechussarin qeriba beolma — en bezeh mishshum koteb, kevan sheepshar lehaqriban beqal beli asiyyat maaseh chadash — hare hen kimqorabim veomedim, veeno oseh kelum biqriba zo. Veken muttar lepotchan mittaam zeh, veeno kemochaqan, kevan shekketibatan qayyemet veepshar lehaqriban beqal, vahare hen kimqorabin. Veken nohagin:
Hammaggiah ot achat, kegon shennatal legaggo shel che"t venaasu shene zayni"n — chayyab. (Vehammaggiah ot achat acheret, kegon shennatal legaggo shel d' vaasao r' — patur, abal asur min hattora):

Eno chayyab ella keshekkoteb bedabar hammitqayyem al gabbe dabar hammitqayyem, abal middibre soperim asur apillu bedabar sheeno mitqayyem al gabbe dabar sheeno mitqayyem, kegon liktob bemashqin ume perot al gabbe ale yeraqot vekayyotze bahen. Velaken tzarik lizzaher shello liktob beetzbao bemashqin al hashshulchan, o lachaqoq beeper o beshuman qarush o bidbash. Abal muttar lirshom baavir kemin otiyyot, kevan sheen rishshuman nikkar kelal. Vehu haddin al hashshulchan shello bemashqin, sheggam bezeh en rishshuman nikkar kelal. Veap al pi sheal yede kak melammed umeammen yado liktiba — en bekak kelum. Veken muttar lirot umanut beshabbat ap al pi shellomedah:

Haqqorea al haor ketabnit ketab — chayyab, shehare chaqiqa hi biklal ketiba. Abal haroshem al haor ketabnit ketab — patur, sheen zeh dabar hammitqayyem. Abal asur middibre soperim, gezera mishshum dabar hammitqayyem. Abal im eno tabnit ketab, veeno roshem ella lesimman beolma velo kemin otiyyot — muttar apillu lekattechilla. Velaken muttar lirshom betzipporen al hasseper kemo sheroshemin lesimman bemaqom sheyyesh taut. Bammeh debarim amurim? Biqlap, shehu qasheh, veharoshem shebbo eno mitqayyem, abal binyar asur lirshom, mippene sheharoshem shebbo mitqayyem zeman merubbeh. Veap al pi sheeno tabnit ketab — asur middibre soperim, gezera mishshum tabnit ketab, shechayyabim alayv keshehu mitqayyem. Veyesh oserim apillu biqlap, lepi shessoberim sheapillu haroshem lesimman beolma velo ketabnit ketab — chayyab im hu dabar hammitqayyem, shekken hayu roshemin al qarshe hammishkan leda ezeh ben zugo. Ulepikak im sarat serita achat al gabbe shene nesarim, o b' seritot al neser echad lesimman kemo sheasu beqarshe hammishkan — chayyab. Ubisrita achat al neser echad — patur, abal asur min hattora, mippene shehu dabar hammitqayyem. Veharoshem al haqqelap sheeno mitqayyem — asur middibre soperim, gezera mishshum hammitqayyem. Vire shamayim yachmir leatzmo kedibrehem:

Vekol zeh kesheeno tabnit ketab kelal, abal kol shehu tabnit ezeh ketab, apillu eno ashshuri, vaapillu enan otiyyot yeduot, ella shergilin lesimman beolma, kegon hassimmanim shergilin laasot bahem hammispar — hare zeh niqra tabnit ketab, vechayyab alayv im asao bedabar hammitqayyem. Ubedabar sheeno mitqayyem — asur middibre soperim ledibre hakkol. Vehakkoteb ashshurit vechisser hazziyyunin mishshaatne"z ge"tz — patur alehen, mippene shello nigmera melaktan. Veken kol ketab meezo umma shello gamar otiyyotayv ketiqqunan — patur alayv, ella sheasur middibre soperim. Velaken hakkoteb ketiba daqqa sheqqorin meshita"a — yesh omerim sheppatur aleha, mippene shennilqecha mikketab ashshuri, vahare zeh kiktab ashshuri shello nigmar ketiqquno, ukemo sheyyitbaer besimman tqm"h:
Im tocheb otiyyot shel kesep bebeged — niqra ketab, veasur laasoto beshabbat:
Haroshem reshamim vetzurot bishtar vekayyotze bahem kederek shehatztzayyarim roshemim — chayyab mishshum toledet koteb, veken hammochaqah:

Derek haratzanim keshehu ba lachtok haor mesarteto techilla kepi mah shehu rotzeh lehaarik leharchib uleqatztzer hachittuk, veachar kak maabir hassakkin derek hassirtut, veken asu beorot hammishkan keshechatakum, velaken sirtut zeh hu meabot melakot. Veken hamsartet apillu haqqelap o hanneyar kede liktob beyosher — chayyab:

Hattoper b' tepirot veqashar, o g' tepirot ap al pi shello qashar — chayyab. Abal b' tepirot velo qashar — patur, mippene sheeno mitqayyem, abal asur middibre soperim. Veim qashar — chayyab gam mishshum qosher:

Beged shehu tapur veomed vehinniach hachut arok venitparedu shette chatikot habbeged zo mizzo bemiqtzat vechute hattepirot nimshakim, umoteach et rosh hachut kede lehaddeqan ulechabberan — zo hi tepiratan, vechayyab ap al pi shello qashar, im nitchabberu keshiur g' tepirot. Veotan shemmehaddeqin habbegadim sebib zerootehem al yede hachut shemmotechim oto umithaddeq — asur lemotcho beshabbat, mishshum toper. (Veap sheenah tepira shel qayyama, shehare eno mehaddeqo ella beshaa shellobesho, ubeshaa shepposheto merappeh oto, mikkol maqom asur middibre soperim, mippene sheddomeh letoper). Ella im ken yihyu hanneqabim rechabim qetzat umetuqqanim bitpira ubeiggul, sheaz eno domeh letoper. Veaz apillu im hachut tachub bemachat nequba — muttar latzet bah, kevan shehi mechubberet leolam bechut vehachut bebeged, vahare hi tashmish habbeged. Veim en habbeged mehuddaq kol kak al yede chut zeh sheyyehe tzarik lerappoto keshepposheto, ella lipamim nimlak umannicho kak leolam, mippene sheyyakol leposhto kak kemot shehu mehuddaq qetzat — asur lehaddeqo beshabbat bekol inyan, shemma yimmalek lehannicho kak leolam, venimtza asa tepira shel qayyama, ubitpira shel qayyama en moil mah shehanneqabim rechabim umetuqqanim bitpira ubeiggul:
Mokin shennapelu min hakkeset — muttar lehachaziram. Abal asur littenam bitchilla bakkeset, mippene sheakshav osehu keli. Ayyen simman shy"z:

Hamammer hu meabot melakot shehaya bammishkan besammanim hazzeruim. Veen immur ella keshemmeassepo bimqom giddulo, keen qama qetzura shemmegabbeb hashshibbolim bimqom giddulan. Veken hamassep perot umeqabbetzan yachad bemaqom shennapelu min hailan. Abal im nitpazzeru bemaqom acher — muttar leqabbetzam, kemo shennitbaer besimman shl"h. Veen immur ella begiddule qarqa. Abal middibre soperim asur ap shello begiddule qarqa leqabbetzam bimqom giddulam, kegon leqabbetz melach mimmisrepot hammayim shessoraptan venaasim melach, veken bekol kayyotze bazeh. (Veyesh omerim shehamdabbeq perot ad shennaasu gup echad — chayyab mishshum meammer apillu shello bimqom giddulam, kegon) hamqabbetz debela veasa mimmennu iggul, o shennaqab teenim vehiknis hachebel bahem ad shennitqabbetzu venaasu gup echad — hare zeh toledet meammer vechayyab, veken kol kayyotze bazeh (vetzarik lehachamir kedibrehem):
Hannoten zera pishtan o shumshemin bemayim vekayyotze bahem — chayyab mishshum lash, mippene shemmitorbim venitlim zeh bazeh:

Ap al pi shechatikat talush mutteret lekattechilla kesheeno maqpid lechatteko bemidda, kemo shennitbaer besimman shy"d, mikkol maqom im al yede zeh metaqqeno lehishtammesh bo ezeh tashmish — chayyab mishshum tiqqun keli im mechatteko besakkin, kemo shennitbaer besimman shk"b gabbe qetimat qesam, veshello besakkin — patur, abal asur. Lepikak, en shoberin et hacheres veen qorein et hanneyar hammuttarim betiltul kede lehishtammesh bahem ezeh tashmish, mippene shehu kimtaqqen keli. Ayyen simman tq"ch. (Abal mishshum qorea — en issur ella kesheqqorea umaprid gupim rabbim shennitchabberu, kegon qorea beged haarug mechutim harbeh. Abal hanneyar shehu gup echad — en bipsiqato vechittuko mishshum qorea. Umittaam zeh muttar liqroa or sheal pi chabit shel yayin, kemo shennitbaer besimman shy"d, mippene shehaor hu gup echad, velo shayyak bo issur qeria ella issur hachittuk im maqpid lechatteko bemidda, kemo shennitbaer sham). Abal hampareq neyarot debuqim — hare zeh toledet qorea. Vehamdabbeq neyarot o orot beqolan shel soperim vekayyotze bo — hare zeh toledot toper vechayyab. Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheddibbuq zeh naaseh leqiyyum, abal dappe separim shennidbequ zeh lezeh al yede shaava o bishat haqqeshira — muttarim lepotchan beshabbat, shekkevan shello naasa leqiyyum, veod shennaasa meelayv belo mitkavven, lepikak eno domeh kelal letoper, veen bo mishshum qorea:
Machat shennitaqqema apillu meat — asur leposhtah, (mishshum tiqqun keli):
